caption.hook:
Armenia has probably never crossed your mind as a travel destination. It hadn't crossed mine either. Then I found a capital that is 29 years older than Rome, monasteries carved into cliffs and an abandoned Soviet radio telescope I got to climb while pigs wandered around the grounds!

It's safe, cheap and not crowded (I didn't wait in a line once). I spent 5 packed days there and my one regret was not staying longer, so this is the 7-day version: Yerevan as your base, the best day trips, then the Black City of Gyumri.
